{{Top|leg}}
'''Meslinger''' was a [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]] with the [[Tyberious Institute of Xenobiology]]. Meslinger visited [[Randorn 2]] and witnessed an [[ibliton]] attack on a [[Mizx]] village. The xenobiologist, with the rest of the team from the Institute, was able to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the creature with their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Meslinger subsequently published an account of the attack and the Mizx funeral rites.<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
